2026年墨西哥城大奖赛排位赛集锦。
汉密尔顿在墨西哥城大奖赛排位赛中力压梅赛德斯车手拉塞尔，拿下加盟法拉利后的首个杆位。
整个周末，汉密尔顿都被他的法拉利队友夏尔·勒克莱尔压制，但他在最关键的时刻于第三节排位赛末尾跑出了自己的最佳圈速，以千分之九秒的优势力压拉塞尔。
这位七届世界冠军自2025赛季初从梅赛德斯转投法拉利以来，已两次拿下冲刺赛杆位，但如今他将自2023年7月以来首次从正赛发车格的头位起步，同时将自己的杆位纪录扩大到105个。
安东内利如何在周日的墨西哥城大奖赛上赢得世界冠军

勒克莱尔在Q3首轮飞驰圈后领先马克斯·维斯塔潘，但两人在最后一轮冲刺中都出现失误，最终分别位列第三和第四。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿以微弱优势击败乔治·拉塞尔，成为自1982年以来最年长的杆位得主。
基米·安东内利如果周日以第九名或更高名次完赛，就将加冕F1史上最年轻世界冠军；他在第五名，落后领先者近0.2秒。
由于维斯塔潘在周五第二节练习赛中与小红牛车手利亚姆·劳森发生碰撞，被罚退后一个发车位，安东内利因此将从第四位发车。
兰多·诺里斯为迈凯伦取得第六名，而他的队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里意外止步于第二节排位赛，这意味着这位澳大利亚车手将从第13位发车。
基米·安东内利即将成为一级方程式历史上最年轻的世界冠军，泰德·克拉维茨回顾了此前打破这一纪录的车手们的历史。
伊萨克·哈贾尔驾驶另一辆红牛赛车获得第七名，领先劳森一个名次，而劳森因周五与维斯塔潘的碰撞，在周日的发车格上同样被罚退后一个位置。
他的小红牛队友阿尔维德·林德布拉德将上升一位至发车格第八位，而阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利则占据前十名的最后一个位置。

detailEn: Mexico City GP Qualifying: Lewis Hamilton claims first pole position for Ferrari by edging out Mercedes' George Russell

Lewis Hamilton claims first grand prix pole position for Ferrari in Mexico City; Hamilton edged out George Russell for first pole since July 2023; watch Sunday's race at 8pm (build-up from 6.30pm) to see if Kimi Antonelli can become champion, live on Sky Sports F1
Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix.
Lewis Hamilton claimed his first pole position for Ferrari by edging out Mercedes' George Russell in qualifying for the Mexico City Grand Prix.

Hamilton had been outpaced by his Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc throughout the weekend but produced his best lap when it mattered most at the end of Q3 to edge out Russell by nine thousandths of a second.

The seven-time world champion has twice claimed Sprint poles since his move from Mercedes to Ferrari at the start of the 2025 season but will now start a grand prix from the front of the grid for the first time since July 2023 after extending his record tally to 105 poles.
How Antonelli can win world title at Mexico City GP on Sunday

Leclerc had led Max Verstappen after the first runs in Q3, but the pair had to settle for third and fourth, respectively, after both making errors on their final efforts.
Lewis Hamilton edged out George Russell to become the oldest person to claim pole position since 1982.
Kimi Antonelli, who will be crowned Formula 1's youngest ever world champion on Sunday if he finishes ninth or higher, was almost two tenths off the pace in fifth.
Antonelli will start from fourth as a result of Verstappen having been handed a one-place grid penalty for a collision with Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson during second practice on Friday.
Lando Norris took sixth for McLaren as his team-mate Oscar Piastri suffered a surprise Q2 exit that leaves the Australian starting 13th.
With Kimi Antonelli on the brink of becoming Formula One's youngest ever world champion, Ted Kravitz looks at the history of those who have broken that record previously.
Isack Hadjar was seventh in the other Red Bull, finishing a place ahead of Lawson, who also drops a position on Sunday's grid for his role in Friday's collision with Verstappen.
His Racing Bulls team-mate Arvid Lindblad will climb a position to eighth on the grid, while Alpine's Pierre Gasly rounds out the top 10.
